title: Detailed lollipop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='pop' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ad5'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ff3f8f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c4125a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stick' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff3dc'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffd9a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e9a95c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stick -->
  <rect x='47' y='50' width='6' height='42' rx='3' fill='url(#stick)'/>
  <rect x='47' y='50' width='2' height='42' fill='#fffdf8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='51' y='50' width='1.5' height='42' fill='#b9752e' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- candy head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='28' fill='#7a0636'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='26' fill='url(#pop)'/>

  <!-- spiral swirl -->
  <path d='M50 36
           C50 30 56 27 60 31
           C65 36 62 44 55 46
           C46 49 38 42 39 34
           C40 24 52 18 63 23
           C75 29 77 45 65 54
           C52 64 34 59 28 45
           C22 30 34 14 50 14
           C67 14 81 28 81 46'
        fill='none' stroke='#ffd1e8' stroke-width='3.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.95'/>

  <!-- inner swirl highlight -->
  <path d='M50 36
           C50 32 54 29 57 32
           C61 36 59 41 55 43
           C48 46 41 40 42 33'
        fill='none' stroke='#fff1f8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- shine -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='24' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#ffe3f2' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-28 40 24)'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='31' r='2' fill='#fff6fb' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- wrapper twist below candy -->
  <path d='M40 58 Q46 62 50 60 Q54 62 60 58 Q58 64 50 66 Q42 64 40 58Z' fill='#ffb3d9'/>
  <path d='M41 59 Q50 63 59 59' fill='none' stroke='#ff6aae' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
